title: Racing baselines: the Follower, the Cutter and the Blocker
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: Racing now has three scripted drivers. The Follower keeps to the middle of the road, the Cutter takes the inside line through every corner, and the Blocker covers the car behind it. Each gets a small seeded jitter, so no two races are alike, and every race still replays exactly.

Measured over 1,000 seeds, every driver finishes 3 laps of the Ring alone, and the Cutter is the fastest (24.62 s against the Follower's 24.80 s). In 4-car races every car finishes, in about 26 s. The Cutter wins 68.4% of mixed races, inside the 70% limit, once it learned to wait in traffic instead of diving inside. The Blocker wins only 8%, which is the first thing evolution should fix.
